question: How can the five Kālīs be one great devourer while manifesting diverse forms?
premises: The five Kālīs are identified as a single entity.
This single entity is characterized as a great devourer.
This same entity manifests in diverse forms.
inference: The multiplicity of the five Kālīs is unified in one supreme devouring power that appears in different forms.
plain_english: She, the fivefold Kālī, is the one great devourer, though having different forms.
